remarks: Welcome to 116 Palmer! This spacious, move-in-ready home offers 1,722 sq ft with 3 bedrooms and 1.5 baths, blending original character with thoughtful updates throughout. Step inside to beautiful hardwood floors that lead into the generous 20' x 13' living room, highlighted by a new gas fireplace (2022). The living room flows seamlessly into the large dining room and a versatile bonus space, currently used as a playroom. A convenient half bath completes this area. The spacious eat-in kitchen offers ample counter space, abundant cabinetry, a pantry, a new Bosch dishwasher (2024), and a new refrigerator (2024). Hardwood floors, recessed lighting and crown molding throughout the first floor add warmth and character. Upstairs, the impressive primary  bedroom spans the entire width of the home and features a walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms, a renovated full bathroom, and an original linen closet offering plenty of storage and complete the second floor. The original hardwood floors and staircase were refinished in 2024. Outside enjoy a fully fenced yard and spacious two-car garage. Additional improvements to the home include: new flat roof (2024), new furnace (2024), central A/C added (2022), replaced downspouts (2023), and basement I-beam work and crawl space encapsulation completed by Frank's Basement (2022). With its great location in Kenmore this home’s spacious layout, original charm, and extensive updates, make this truly turn-key and ready for its next owners! Showings start at open house Tuesday, 10/20 from 4-6!
